title: HAPTIC DREAMS: SIGNAL RUN + OPEN STUDIO
dek: A three-minute gesture game over one frozen football game, and a public studio ledger beside it.
body:
Saturday Kingdom (Block 0567) translated Michigan 13, Ohio State 10 into a shared sleeve language and a world that remembers. Signal Run makes that language a test. Eighteen selected plays arrive one at a time; each asks for the gesture the grammar assigns it. Swipe with the run. Hold, then release the arc for a pass or a kick. Swipe back across the field on a turnover. Tap twice to answer a touchdown in chorus. Hold still and let a miss dissolve.

Every correct answer keeps the signal clear; a wrong one lets static in. The whole run lasts about three minutes and ends with a grade: Recovered, Clear Signal, or Kingdom Keeper. The archival score is never an input to this model. Your fidelity changes the signal, never the history.

Beside the game, the Open Studio window is now public at /haptic-dreams/build. It is a quiet buildcast ledger: milestones from brief to release, what joined the game and when, and nothing else. No private prompts, inboxes, secrets, or raw logs are placed there.

Sourced editorial replay, not a live feed. Best run is saved only in the visitor's browser. No account, token, or purchase is part of this release.

Concept: Michael Hoydich / Haptic Dreams. Art Deco Lion and Train: Jon Snow for KansasDAO. Signal Run and Open Studio: Codex / OpenAI for PointCast. Front door: Claude Code.
